title: Multiplication of rational numbers
competency: Multiply rational numbers and use the properties of multiplication.

keywords.def: A fraction whose top and bottom share no common factor except 1.
a × (b + c) = a × b + a × c.

en.text: To multiply fractions, multiply the numerators and multiply the denominators. Then reduce. Change mixed numbers to improper fractions first. On a grid, 3/4 × 1/2 is the part shaded twice.

am.text: ክፍልፋዮችን ለማባዛት ላዕላዮቹን አባዛ፣ ተካፋዮቹንም አባዛ። ከዚያ አቅልል። ድብልቅ ቁጥሮችን መጀመሪያ ወደ ኢ-ትክክለኛ ቀይር።

screens.title: Half of three-quarters
screens.ask: You eat half of 3/4 of an injera. How much of the injera is that?
screens.after:
Half of 3/4 means 1/2 × 3/4.
Multiply the tops: 1 × 3 = 3. Multiply the bottoms: 2 × 4 = 8.
So half of 3/4 is 3/8. Check it on the grid below.
(1/4 is too small: half of 3/4 is more than half of 2/4 = 1/4.)

screens.title: Grid model: 1/2 × 3/4
screens.intro: The square is 1 whole. Tap Next step.
say: Cut the square into 2 equal columns. Shade 1 column (blue). That is 1/2 of the square.
Now cut it into 4 equal rows. Shade 3 rows (yellow). That is 3/4 of the square.
The square now has 2 × 4 = 8 equal boxes. 3 boxes are shaded with both colours. So 3/4 of 1/2 is 3/8: 3/4 × 1/2 = 3/8.

screens.title: Multiplying
paras: Multiply the numerator by the numerator.
Multiply the denominator by the denominator.
Then reduce the answer to its lowest terms.

steps: a) 3/2 × 7/8: multiply the tops, 3 × 7 = 21, and the bottoms, 2 × 8 = 16.
So 3/2 × 7/8 = 21/16. 21 and 16 share no factor, so it is already in lowest terms.
b) −5/6 × 4/3: the signs are different, so the product is negative.
Simplify: 20 and 18 are both divisible by 2 (their GCF).

screens.title: Key words
defs: Top and bottom share no common factor except 1.

screens.why:
Multiply the numerators: 5 × 8 = 40.
Multiply the denominators: 7 × 11 = 77.
So the product is 40/77.
40 = 2 × 2 × 2 × 5 and 77 = 7 × 11 share no factor, so it is in lowest terms.

Multiply the numerators: 5 × 3 = 15.
Multiply the denominators: 8 × 4 = 32.
So 5/8 × 3/4 = 15/32.
15 and 32 share no factor, so it is in lowest terms.

Change to improper fractions: 3 2/5 = (3 × 5 + 2)/5 = 17/5.
2 4/7 = (2 × 7 + 4)/7 = 18/7.
Multiply: 17 × 18 = 306 and 5 × 7 = 35.
So the product is 306/35 = 8 26/35.

"Of" means multiply. Start from the right: 2/3 of 36.

en.text: Same signs give a positive product. Different signs give a negative product. Any number times 0 is 0. With many factors, an even number of negatives gives a positive answer; an odd number gives a negative answer.

steps: The signs are different (+ and −), so the product is negative.

screens.why:
Both factors are negative: the signs are the same.
Same signs give a positive product.
Size: (2 × 7)/(5 × 3) = 14/15.
So the product is +14/15: positive.

The signs are different, so the product is negative.
Multiply the sizes: 3 × 3 = 9 and 7 × 4 = 28.
So 3/7 × 3/4 = 9/28.
Put the sign in front: −9/28.

Both are negative: same signs give +.
Multiply the sizes: 8 × 3 = 24 and 7 × 5 = 35.
So the product is 24/35.
Answer: +24/35.

Count the negative factors: 1 (odd), so the product is negative.
Multiply the tops: 2 × 5 × 3 = 30. Multiply the bottoms: 3 × 4 × 2 = 24.
So the size is 30/24.
The GCF of 30 and 24 is 6: 30 ÷ 6 = 5 and 24 ÷ 6 = 4.
Answer: −5/4 = −1 1/4.
screens.worked:
1 negative factor (odd), so the answer is negative.
2 × 5 × 3 = 30 and 3 × 4 × 2 = 24.
30/24 = 5/4 (divide by 6).
Answer −5/4.

screens.text: Sign rules: the product of 7 numbers is negative. How many of them can be negative?
screens.why:
Each pair of negatives multiplies to a positive.
So an even number of negatives gives +, and an odd number gives −.
The product is negative, so the count of negatives is odd.
Of 7 factors: 1, 3, 5 or 7 can be negative.
screens.clue: Even number of negatives → positive. Odd number → negative.

en.text: Multiplication is commutative and associative. It distributes over addition: a × (b + c) = a × b + a × c. Times 0 gives 0. Times 1 keeps the number.

am.text: ማባዛት የመለዋወጥና የመቧደን ባሕሪ አለው። በመደመር ላይ ይከፋፈላል። በ0 ማባዛት 0 ይሰጣል። በ1 ማባዛት ቁጥሩን አይለውጥም።

screens.ask: Cloth costs Birr 162/4 per metre. Roughly how much do 35/9 m cost?
screens.after:
Estimate: 35/9 ≈ 4 m and 162/4 ≈ Birr 40 per metre. 4 × 40 = Birr 160.
Exact: 35/9 × 162/4 = (35 × 162)/(9 × 4) = 5670/36.
The GCF of 5670 and 36 is 18: 5670 ÷ 18 = 315 and 36 ÷ 18 = 2.
315/2 = Birr 157.50, close to the estimate.

paras: For any rational numbers a, b and c, five properties hold.
Tap each property below to see an example.

steps: Now add 6/35 + 8/15. The LCM of 35 and 15 is 105.

screens.title: Distributive property
defs: a × (b + c) = a × b + a × c.

screens.title: Properties of multiplication: match each line to its property
screens.why:
(8/9 × 5/4) × 0 = 0: anything times 0 is 0. Property of 0.
2 3/5 × 1 = 2 3/5: times 1 changes nothing. Property of 1.
3/5 × 6/7 = 6/7 × 3/5: the order is swapped. Commutative.
2/5 × (3/7 + 4/3) = 2/5 × 3/7 + 2/5 × 4/3: the brackets are opened. Distributive.
screens.clue: Look for 0, 1, swapped order, or brackets opened.

screens.ask: Multiply in a word problem: a plane covers 1250 km per hour. In 23/6 hours it covers ___ km
screens.why:
Distance = speed × time = 1250 × 23/6.
1250 × 23 = 28750, so 28750/6.
Divide top and bottom by 2: 14375/3.
14375 ÷ 3 = 4791 remainder 2, so 4791 2/3 ≈ 4791.67 km.

screens.ask: Evaluate the expression: −3(5x + 5) when x = 3/4. Answer: ___

screens.why:
Both parts have the factor 7/8.
Take it out: 7/8 × (13 − 5).
13 − 5 = 8.
7/8 × 8 = 56/8 = 7.
screens.clue: Both parts have 7/8. Take it out of the brackets.

test.text: Sign rules: the product of three negative numbers is
test.why:
Two negatives multiply to a positive.
That positive times the third negative is negative.
Three is odd, so the product is negative.
Example: (−1) × (−1) × (−1) = −1.

Same signs: the product is positive.
Sizes: 3 × 8 = 24 and 4 × 9 = 36.
24/36: divide by 12 to get 2/3.
Answer: 2/3.
